title: Pehla Laravel Project Banana aur Chalana
objectives: Development server chalana aur browser mein dekhna
Default SQLite database aur MySQL par switch karna
Pehla route aur Blade view banana
prerequisites: Local Setup: PHP, Composer, Node aur Laravel Installer (m02-l02)

sections.heading: Project banana
sections.body: Terminal mein woh folder kholo jahan project rakhna hai aur yeh command chalao. Installer tumse kuch sawaal poochta hai (jaise starter kit, testing framework). Seekhne ke liye starter kit **None** rakhna theek hai.
explain: Project banate waqt Laravel ek `database/database.sqlite` file banata hai aur zaroori migrations bhi chala deta hai.

sections.heading: Server chalana
sections.body: Assets build karo aur development server shuru karo. Browser mein `http://localhost:8000` kholo. Tumhe Laravel ka welcome page dikhna chahiye.

code.code:
npm install && npm run build
composer run dev

explain: `composer run dev` – local server, queue worker aur Vite dev server ek saath chalata hai (Laravel 13 docs mein yahi tareeka hai).
`php artisan serve` – sirf PHP server chalata hai. Port badalna ho to `php artisan serve --port=8001`.
Server band karne ke liye terminal mein `Ctrl + C`.

sections.heading: Database: SQLite default hai
sections.body: Default `.env` mein Laravel SQLite use karta hai, to abhi koi database install karne ki zarurat nahi. Agar MySQL ya PostgreSQL chahiye, to `.env` ke `DB_*` variables badlo, database banao aur migrate chalao.

code.code:
DB_CONNECTION=mysql
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
DB_PORT=3306
DB_DATABASE=laravel
DB_USERNAME=root
DB_PASSWORD=

sections.heading: Real-world example: Apna pehla page
sections.body: Chalo ek `/hello` page banate hain. Pehle route, phir uska Blade view.

code.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/', function () {
    return view('welcome');
});

Route::get('/hello', fn () => view('hello', ['name' => 'Dost']));

explain: `view('hello', [...])` – `resources/views/hello.blade.php` ko data ke saath render karta hai.
`{{ $name }}` – Blade mein variable print karne ka tareeka (aage Module 05 mein detail).

versionDiff.heading: Project banane aur chalane ke tareeke
versionDiff.intro: `laravel new` hamesha latest version (abhi Laravel 13) banata hai. Purana version chahiye to Composer se version dena padta hai.

items.11: `composer create-project laravel/laravel:^11.0 example-app` se banta hai. Server ke liye `php artisan serve` safe tareeka hai.
items.12: `composer create-project laravel/laravel:^12.0 example-app` se banta hai. 12 ke skeleton mein bhi `composer run dev` milta hai.
items.13: `laravel new example-app` se seedha Laravel 13 banta hai. Server aur Vite ek saath `composer run dev` se.

errors.error: Vite manifest not found at: public/build/manifest.json
errors.fix: `npm install && npm run build` chalao, ya development ke liye `npm run dev` (ya `composer run dev`) chalu rakho.

errors.error: Failed to listen on 127.0.0.1:8000 (reason: Address already in use)
errors.cause: Port 8000 par pehle se koi aur server chal raha hai.
errors.fix: Purana server band karo, ya `php artisan serve --port=8001` use karo.

errors.cause: `.env` mein MySQL set hai par MySQL server band hai ya credentials galat hain.
errors.fix: MySQL start karo, `DB_*` values check karo, ya wapas `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite` karke seekho.

debug.body: Project ki sehat dekhne ke liye `php artisan about` use karo. Errors `storage/logs/laravel.log` mein milte hain.

code.code:
php artisan about
php artisan route:list
tail -f storage/logs/laravel.log   # Windows PowerShell: Get-Content storage/logs/laravel.log -Wait

tasks: `laravel new example-app` se project banao aur welcome page dekho
`php artisan serve --port=8001` se alag port par chalao

quiz.q: Laravel ka default database kaunsa hai?
quiz.why: Naye project mein `.env` SQLite use karta hai aur `database/database.sqlite` ban jaati hai.
Running process ko `Ctrl + C` se rokte hain.

interview.a: `laravel new app-name` (installer) ya `composer create-project laravel/laravel app-name`.
PHP ka built-in development server chalata hai, default `http://localhost:8000` par. Production ke liye nahi hai.

interview.q: Default database ko MySQL kaise karte hain?
interview.a: `.env` mein `DB_CONNECTION=mysql` aur `DB_*` values set karke `php artisan migrate` chalate hain.
`composer.json` ki `dev` script chalata hai jo development server, queue worker aur Vite ek saath start karti hai.

interview.q: Vite manifest error kyun aata hai?
interview.a: Jab assets build nahi hue hote. `npm run build` ya `npm run dev` se solve hota hai.

summary: `laravel new` se project banta hai, default database SQLite.
`composer run dev` ya `php artisan serve` se server chalta hai.
MySQL ke liye `.env` ke `DB_*` badlo aur `php artisan migrate` chalao.
Route + Blade view se pehla page banta hai.
